instrument: Spectrum analyzer (Rohde & Schwarz FSW8 / FSW13 / FSW26 / FSW43 / FSW50 / FSW67 / FSW85)
source: Transcribed from the R&S FSW Signal and Spectrum Analyzer User Manual (1173.9411.02, version 56), chapter 13 Remote commands. Only 13.1 to 13.13 are read: 13.14 documents other manufacturers' commands for emulation mode, 13.15 is the deprecated set and 13.16 is prose. The parse is checked against the manual's own List of Commands (base unit) and anything that header index does not list is dropped, which is what keeps the abbreviated command lines inside the programming examples out. 1316 of the 1367 listed headers are documented in the chapter with a description and are here; of the 51 that are not, 30 are listed but never documented in this chapter, 9 carry a label block or a fragment where the description would be, and 2 appear only as a cross-reference. Query forms come from the manual's stated rule that a query exists for every setting command unless a Usage field says Query only, Setting only or Event.
